text:
sarah_support: FYI customer (Acme Corp, project: acme-prod) hit a 403 when trying to open the project console after SSO change.
sarah_support: Error they see in UI: "You do not have permission to view this project (403)". Console shows a missing role mapping.
sarah_support: Repro steps from customer:
1) login via Okta
2) SSO redirect returns, console loads but the Projects list is empty
3) navigating to /projects/acme-prod returns 403 immediately
sarah_support: They say they were fine yesterday, and the IdP rolled out a tweak overnight that may have trimmed a claim.
aditya_engineer: Can you paste the id_token payload (redacted) or the claim name they map for role? Usually we map `roles` or `app_claims.roles`.
sarah_support: Sent the token (PII scrubbed) to the thread. Token shows `groups` claim truncated to 128 chars, looks like multiple group names concatenated and cut off.
aditya_engineer: sounds like group->role mapping failed because Okta shortened the `groups` claim. If the group containing `acme-prod-admins` got truncated we won't surface the role.
aditya_engineer: Quick workaround: add the user to an SCIM-provisioned group that maps to project role OR invite the user directly to the project via admin console (email invite) until IdP is fixed.
mike_sre: Logged: push a short-lived fix to Console to fallback to SCIM membership if JWT `groups` is missing. But that's risky for edge cases.
aditya_engineer: For immediate customer resolution I recommend: 1) resync Okta SCIM groups for the org, 2) re-auth the affected user, 3) confirm `roles` claim contains `acme-prod-admin`.
olivia_cse: Customer tried `okta groupsync` and saw a delay, but after forcing a SCIM resync their access returned for two users and one still gets 403.
aditya_engineer: For the remaining user can you ask them to paste `jwt.ms` output or run:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://auth.example.com/introspect
```
We just need the `groups` claim snippet.
sarah_support: Customer provided introspect output in DM: `groups: ["eng-team","acme-...truncated"]` so it's definitely truncated.
aditya_engineer: Root cause: IdP claim length limit causing truncation of concatenated groups string. Mapping expects exact group name. We'll implement a safer mapping: check SCIM membership if claim doesn't match, and log mismatch to ease debugging.
aditya_engineer: I'll open a ticket to engineering; plan: (a) add SCIM fallback in auth flow, (b) add instrumentation to log when a claim truncation is detected, (c) docs / runbook for customers.
mike_sre: Risk assessment: low for immediate change, but need tests for scale. Put rollback plan in PR.
\saditya_engineer: (typo) meant @aditya_engineer :)
olivia_cse: Customer asked if there's a permanent fix on their side — what should we advise? Should they change Okta setting to send `groups` as array instead of concatenated string?
aditya_engineer: Yes. Best long-term advice: configure IdP to emit `groups` as an array claim (not a single long string) or enable group filtering so relevant groups are included. Also increase claim size or switch to SCIM group sync.
sarah_support: Customer accepted workaround: SCIM resync + re-invite for the one user. They're ok with a follow-up once we deploy a fallback.
aditya_engineer: I'll create ENG-4521 to add SCIM fallback and detection alerts. I'll ping when PR is up for review.
mike_sre: I'll schedule a quick canary to make sure no auth storms from the change. +1 on alerting.
sarah_support: Thanks all — closing the support ticket after confirming the one user regained access. Will reopen if anything reoccurs. :thumbsup:
